title: Merge intervals
statement:
You are given n closed intervals [a, b]. Merge every group of intervals that overlap and print the result. Two intervals overlap when they share at least one point, so [1, 3] and [3, 5] merge into [1, 5], while [1, 2] and [3, 4] stay apart.

Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 20000). Each of the next n lines holds two integers a b (-10^9 <= a <= b <= 10^9). The intervals are in no particular order.
Output: first a line with the number of merged intervals, then one line "a b" per merged interval, in increasing order of a.

Example
Input:
4
8 10
1 3
2 6
15 18
Output:
3
1 6
8 10
15 18
